rawContent: Finally, some #climate news to celebrate! Sending a huge thank you to all legislative champions & all RAD members, partners and supporters for your hard work to hold #Vermont accountable to meeting strong emissions reduction targets. #vtpoli #ActOnClimate #togetherwewin

There are simply no words. Our hearts go out to Breonna Taylor's family & our thoughts are with those in the streets tonight demanding #JusticeForBreonnaTaylor after this painful decision. We will keep organizing for a world where this can't happen. #BlackLivesMatter

We stand with RAD-endorsed candidates @emmaforvthouse @TaylorSmallVT @MariInTheHouse & @selene_colburn in their recent decision to reject @VSEAUnite endorsement given inconsistencies in support for #BlackLivesMatter & opposition to police reform. https://t.co/Hy76vo1vZ3 #vtpoli

We are happy to see several RAD-endorsed statewide candidates condemn Trump & reaffirm their commitment to undoing systemic racism after Tuesday's debate. @zuckermanforvt @mollyforvermont @TreasurerPearce @douglashoffer #vtpoli #condemnwhitesupremacy #EndRacism #Blacklivesmatter

Putney's #BlackLivesMatter mural creation process shows how symbolic steps can be a starting point for a much bigger dialogue & accountability to reckoning with systemic racism & its embeddedness in often largely white VT decision-making spaces. https://t.co/IwVrOS5UoE

#Climatechange is already impacting our VT farms & forests. We need national & state leaders NOW who will make it a top priority to get us to net zero through a just transition guaranteeing jobs, basic needs & racial justice. https://t.co/4wGu4z0mIc #voteforclimate #gotv
We are excited to spend some time today listening to Episodes 1 & 2 of this new climate podcast, "A Matter of Degrees"! #ClimateEmergency https://t.co/f3oo002g2I

Happening today- Burlington area folks, join if you can. We must keep marching against police violence until we live in a world where it doesn’t exist. #BlackLivesMatter #WalterWallace https://t.co/ydu1eOQ2ag https://t.co/gyYzweQAri
